senses: Uriah: [[r:MAT.1.6|Mat 1:6.]]† (AS)

G3739.root: probably a primary word (or perhaps a form of the article [[w:G3588]])
G3739.strongs: the relatively (sometimes demonstrative) pronoun, who, which, what, that
G3739.kjv: one, (an-, the) other, some, that, what, which, who(-m, -se), etc
senses: the postpositive article (ἄρθρον ὑποτακτικόν).
I

As demonstr. pron. = οὗτος, ὅδε, this, that, also for αὐτός, chiefly in nom.: ὅς δέ, but he (cf. ἦ δὲ ὅς, frequently in Plat.), [[r:MRK.15.23|Mrk 15:23]], [[r:JHN.5.11|Jhn 5:11]]; ὃς μὲν... ὃς δέ, the one... the other, [[r:MAT.21.35|Mat 21:35, 22:5, 25:15]], [[r:LUK.23.33|Luk 23:33]], [[r:ACT.27.14|Act 27:14]], [[r:ROM.14.5|Rom 14:5]], [[r:1CO.11.21|1Co 11:21]], [[r:2CO.2.18|2Co 2:18]], Ju 22; neut., ὃ μὲν... ὃ δέ, the one... the other, some... some, [[r:MAT.13.8|Mat 13:8, 23]], [[r:ROM.9.21|Rom 9:21]]; ὃς (ὃ) μὲν... (ἄλλος (ἄλλο))... ἕτερος, [[r:MRK.4.4|Mrk 4:4]], [[r:LUK.8.5|Luk 8:5]], [[r:1CO.12.8|1Co 12:8-10]]; οὓς μέν, absol., [[r:1CO.12.28|1Co 12:28]]; ὃς μὲν... ὁ δέ, [[r:ROM.14.2|Rom 14:2.]]
II
As relat. pron., who, which, what, that;
agreeing in gender with its antecedent, but differently governed as to case: [[r:MAT.2.9|Mat 2:9]], [[r:LUK.9.9|Luk 9:9]], [[r:ACT.20.18|Act 20:18]], [[r:ROM.2.29|Rom 2:29]], al. mult.
In variation from the common construction;

in gender, agreeing with a noun in apposition to the antecedent: [[r:MRK.15.16|Mrk 15:16]], [[r:GAL.3.16|Gal 3:16]], [[r:EPH.6.17|Eph 6:17]], al.; constr. ad sensum: [[r:JHN.6.9|Jhn 6:9]], [[r:COL.2.19|Col 2:19]], [[r:1TI.3.16|1Ti 3:16]], [[r:REV.13.14|Rev 13:14]], al.;

in number, constr. ad sensum: [[r:ACT.15.36|Act 15:36]], [[r:2PE.3.1|2Pe 3:1]]; (with) in case, by attraction to the case of the antecedent (Bl., §50, 2): [[r:JHN.4.18|Jhn 4:18]], [[r:ACT.3.21|Act 3:21]], [[r:ROM.15.18|Rom 15:18]], [[r:1CO.6.19|1Co 6:19]], [[r:EPH.1.8|Eph 1:8]], al.

The neut. ὅ with nouns of other gender and with phrases, which thing, which term: [[r:MRK.3.17|Mrk 3:17 12:42]], [[r:JHN.1.39|Jhn 1:39]], [[r:COL.3.14|Col 3:14]], al.; with a sentence, [[r:ACT.2.32|Act 2:32]], [[r:GAL.2.10|Gal 2:10]], [[r:1JN.2.8|1Jn 2:8]], al.

With ellipse of a demonstrative (οὗτος or ἐκεῖνος), before or after: before, [[r:MAT.20.23|Mat 20:23]], [[r:LUK.7.43|Luk 7:43]], [[r:ROM.10.14|Rom 10:14]], al.; after, [[r:MAT.10.38|Mat 10:38]], [[r:MRK.9.40|Mrk 9:40]], [[r:JHN.19.22|Jhn 19:22]], [[r:ROM.2.1|Rom 2:1]] al.
Expressing purpose, end or cause: [[r:MAT.11.10|Mat 11:10]] (who = that he may), [[r:MRK.1.2|Mrk 1:2]], [[r:HEB.12.6|Heb 12:6]] al.

C. prep, as periphrasis for conjc.: ἀνθ᾽ ὧν ( = ἀντὶ τούτων ὧν), because, [[r:LUK.1.20|Luk 1:20]], al.; wherefore, [[r:LUK.12.3|Luk 12:3]]; ἐξ οὗ, since, for that, [[r:ROM.5.12|Rom 5:12]]; ἀφ᾽ οὗ, since (temporal), [[r:LUK.13.25|Luk 13:25]]; ἐξ οὗ, whence, [[r:PHP.3.20|Php 3:20]]; etc.
With particles: ὃς ἄν (ἐάν), see: ἄν, ἐάν; ὃς καί, [[r:MRK.3.19|Mrk 3:19]], [[r:JHN.21.20|Jhn 21:20]], [[r:ROM.5.2|Rom 5:2]], al.; ὃς καὶ αὐτός, [[r:MAT.27.57|Mat 27:57.]]
Gen., οὗ, absol., as adv. (see: οὗ). (AS)

G3767.kjv: and (so, truly), but, now (then), so (likewise then), then, therefore, verily, wherefore
senses: particle expressing consequence or simple sequence (never standing first in a sentence), wherefore, therefore, then: [[r:MAT.3.10|Mat 3:10]], [[r:LUK.3.9|Luk 3:9]], [[r:JHN.8.38|Jhn 8:38]], [[r:ACT.1.21|Act 1:21]], [[r:ROM.5.9|Rom 5:9]], al.; in exhortations, [[r:MAT.3.8|Mat 3:8]], [[r:LUK.11.35|Luk 11:35]], [[r:ACT.3.19|Act 3:19]], [[r:ROM.6.12|Rom 6:12]], al.; in questions, [[r:MAT.13.28|Mat 13:28]], [[r:MRK.15.12|Mrk 15:12]], Jhn.8:, [[r:ROM.6.1|Rom 6:1]], al.; continuing a narrative or resuming it after a digression, [[r:MAT.1.17|Mat 1:17]], [[r:LUK.3.18|Luk 3:18]], [[r:JHN.1.22|Jhn 1:22 2:18]] (and very frequently in this Gospel), [[r:ACT.26.22|Act 26:22]], al.; ἄρα οὖν (see: ἄρα); ἐπεὶ οὖν, [[r:HEB.2.14|Heb 2:14]]; οὖν with ptcp. (= ἐπεὶ οὖν), [[r:ACT.2.30|Act 2:30]], [[r:ROM.5.1|Rom 5:1]], al.; ἐὰν οὖν (where οὖν rather in sense belongs to the apodosis), [[r:MAT.5.23|Mat 5:23]], [[r:LUK.4.7|Luk 4:7]], [[r:JHN.6.62|Jhn 6:62]], [[r:ROM.2.26|Rom 2:26]], al.; ὡς οὖν, [[r:JHN.4.1|Jhn 4:1]], al. (AS)

G3779.forms: οὕτως, rarely (Bl., §5, 4; WH, App., 146f.) οὕτω, adv.
G3779.strongs: in this way (referring to what precedes or follows)
G3779.kjv: after that, after (in) this manner, as, even (so), for all that, like(-wise), no more, on this fashion(-wise), so (in like manner), thus, what
senses: (οὗτος), in this way, so, thus;

Referring to what follows: [[r:MAT.1.18|Mat 1:18 6:9]], [[r:LUK.19.31|Luk 19:31]], [[r:JHN.21.1|Jhn 21:1]], [[r:1PE.2.15|1Pe 2:15]]; bef. quotations from OT, [[r:MAT.2.5|Mat 2:5]], [[r:ACT.7.6|Act 7:6]], [[r:1CO.15.45|1Co 15:45]], [[r:HEB.4.4|Heb 4:4]].
C. adj. (marking intensity): [[r:HEB.12.21|Heb 12:21]], [[r:REV.16.18|Rev 16:18]]; similarly with adv., [[r:GAL.1.6|Gal 1:6]] (cl.).

As a predicate (Bl., §76, 1): [[r:MAT.1.18|Mat 1:18 9:33]], [[r:MRK.2.1|Mrk 2:1, 2 4:26]], [[r:ROM.4.18|Rom 4:18 9:20]], [[r:1PE.2.15|I Pe 2:15]]; οὕ ἔχειν (Lat. sic or ita se habere), [[r:ACT.7.1|Act 7:1]], al.; ἐκαθέζετο (as he was, without delay or preparation), [[r:JHN.4.6|Jhn 4:6.]]

In comparison, with correlative adv.: καθάπερ... οὕ., [[r:ROM.12.4|Rom 12:4]], 5 al.; καθὼς... οὕ., [[r:LUK.11.30|Luk 11:30]], al.; οὕ.... καθώς, [[r:LUK.24.24|Luk 24:24]], al.; ὡς... οὕ., [[r:ROM.5.15|Rom 5:15]], al.; οὕ... ὡς, [[r:MRK.4.26|Mrk 4:26]], al; ὥσπερ... οὕ., [[r:MAT.12.40|Mat 12:40]], al.; οὕ.... οὕ., [[r:1CO.7.7|1Co 7:7.]] (AS)

G3778.forms: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο, genitive, τούτου, ταύτης, τούτου
G3778.strongs: the he (she or it), i.e. this or that (often with article repeated)
G3778.kjv: he (it was that), hereof, it, she, such as, the same, these, they, this (man, same, woman), which, who
senses: demonstr. pron. (related to ἐκεῖνος as hic to ille), this;
as subst., this one, he;

epanaleptic (referring to what precedes): [[r:MAT.5.19|Mat 5:19]], [[r:MRK.3.35|Mrk 3:35]], [[r:LUK.9.48|Luk 9:48]], [[r:JHN.6.46|Jhn 6:46]], [[r:ROM.7.10|Rom 7:10]], al.; (with) proleptic (referring to what follows): before ἵνα (Bl., §69, 6), [[r:LUK.1.43|Luk 1:43]], [[r:JHN.3.19|Jhn 3:19]] (and freq.) 15:8, [[r:ROM.14.9|Rom 14:9]], al.; before ὅτι, [[r:LUK.10.11|Luk 10:11]], [[r:JHN.9.3|Jhn 9:3]]o, [[r:ACT.24.14|Act 24:14]], [[r:ROM.2.3|Rom 2:3]], al.; ὅπως, [[r:ROM.9.17|Rom 9:17]]; ἐάν, [[r:JHN.13.35|Jhn 13:35]];

special idioms: τοῦτο μὲν... τ. δέ (cl), partly... partly. [[r:HEB.10.33|Heb 10:33]]; καὶ τοῦτο (τοῦτον, ταῦτα), and that (him) too, [[r:ROM.13.11|Rom 13:11]], [[r:1CO.2.2|1Co 2:2]], [[r:HEB.11.12|Heb 11:12]]; τοῦτ᾽ ἐστιν, [[r:MAT.27.46|Mat 27:46.]]
As adj., with subst.;
with subst. anarth. (with predicative force; Bl., §49, 4): [[r:LUK.1.36|Luk 1:36 2:2 24:21]], [[r:JHN.2.11|Jhn 2:11 4:54 21:14]], [[r:2CO.13.1|2Co 13:1]]. (AS)

G3756.forms: οὐ, before a vowel with smooth breathing οὐκ, before one with rough breathing οὐχ (but improperly οὐχ ἰδού, [[r:ACT.2.7|Act 2:7]], WH, mg.; cf. WH, Intr., §409; M, Pr., 44, 244)
G3756.strongs: the absolute negative (compare) adverb; no or not
G3756.kjv: + long, nay, neither, never, no (X man), none, (can-)not, + nothing, + special, un(-worthy), when, + without, + yet but
senses: neg. particle, not, no, used generally with indic, and for a denial of fact (cf. μή);

Most frequently negativing a verb or other word, [[r:MAT.1.25|Mat 1:25 10:26, 38]], [[r:MRK.3.25|Mrk 3:25 9:37]], [[r:JHN.8.29|Jhn 8:29]], [[r:ACT.7.5|Act 7:5]], [[r:ROM.1.16|Rom 1:16]], [[r:PHP.3.3|Php 3:3]], al.; in litotes, οὐκ ὀλίγοι (i.e. very many), [[r:ACT.17.4|Act 17:4]], al.; οὐκ ἄσημος, [[r:ACT.21.39|Act 21:39]]; πᾶς... οὐ, with verb, (like Heb. כֹּל... לֹא), no, none, [[r:MAT.24.22|Mat 24:22]], [[r:MRK.13.20|Mrk 13:20]], [[r:LUK.1.37|Luk 1:37]], [[r:EPH.5.5|Eph 5:5]], al.; in disjunctive statements, οὐκ... ἀλλά, [[r:LUK.8.52|Luk 8:52]] [[r:JHN.1.33|Jhn 1:33]] [[r:ROM.8.2|Rom 8:2]]o, al.; with 2 of person(s) fut. (like Heb. לֹא, with impf.), as emphatic prohibition, [[r:MAT.4.7|Mat 4:7]], [[r:LUK.4.12|Luk 4:12]], [[r:ROM.7.7|Rom 7:7]], al.
With another negative,
strengthening the negation: [[r:MRK.5.37|Mrk 5:37]], [[r:JHN.8.15|Jhn 8:15 12:19]], [[r:ACT.8.39|Act 8:39]], al.;
making an affirmative: [[r:ACT.4.20|Act 4:20]], [[r:1CO.12.15|1Co 12:15]].
With other particles: οὐ μή (see: μή); οὐ μηκέτι, [[r:MAT.21.19|Mat 21:19]]; with μή interrog., [[r:ROM.10.18|Rom 10:18]], [[r:1CO.9.4|1Co 9:4, 5 11:22]].
Interrogative, expecting an affirmative answer (Lat. nonne): [[r:MAT.6.26|Mat 6:26]], [[r:MRK.4.21|Mrk 4:21]], [[r:LUK.11.40|Luk 11:40]], [[r:JHN.4.35|Jhn 4:35]], [[r:ROM.9.21|Rom 9:21]], al. (AS)

G3708.root: properly, to stare at (compare [[w:G3700]]), i.e. (by implication) to discern clearly (physically or mentally)
G3708.strongs: by extension, to attend to; by Hebraism, to experience; passively, to appear
senses: in "durative" sense (hence aor. act., εἶδον, pass., ὤφθην, fut., ὄψομαι, from different roots; see M, Pr., 110f.), to see (in colloq. even the present is rare, its place being generally taken by θεωρέω, see BL, §24).

Of bodily vision, to see, perceive, behold: absol., [[r:MRK.6.38|Mrk 6:38]], al.; ἔρχου καὶ ἴδε, [[r:JHN.1.46|Jhn 1:46]], al.; before ὅτι, [[r:MRK.2.16|Mrk 2:16]], al.; with accusative, [[r:MAT.2.2|Mat 2:2]], [[r:MRK.1.10|Mrk 1:10 16:7]], [[r:GAL.1.19|Gal 1:19]], al.; θεόν, [[r:JHN.1.18|Jhn 1:18]], [[r:1JN.4.20|1Jn 4:20]], al.
to see with the mind, perceive, discern: absol, [[r:ROM.15.21|Rom 15:21]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MAT.9.2|Mat 9:2 27:54]], [[r:ACT.8.23|Act 8:23]], [[r:COL.2.18|Col 2:18]], al.

to see, take heed, beware: ὅρα μή, with aor. subjc., [[r:MAT.8.4|Mat 8:4 18:10]], [[r:MRK.1.44|Mrk 1:44]], [[r:1TH.5.15|1Th 5:15]]; id., sc. μὴ ποήσῃς, [[r:REV.19.10|Rev 19:10 22:9]] (Bl., §81, 1); before imperat. [[r:MAT.9.30|Mat 9:30 16:6]], [[r:MRK.8.15|Mrk 8:15]]
to experience: τ. θάνατον, [[r:LUK.2.26|Luk 2:26]], [[r:HEB.11.5|Heb 11:5]]; ζωήν, [[r:JHN.3.36|Jhn 3:36]]; τ. διαφθοράν, [[r:ACT.2.27|Act 2:27.]]
to visit: with accusative of person(s), [[r:LUK.8.20|Luk 8:20]], [[r:JHN.12.21|Jhn 12:21]], [[r:ROM.1.11|Rom 1:11]], al.; with accusative loc, [[r:ACT.19.21|Act 19:21.]]
to see to, care for: [[r:MAT.27.4|Mat 27:4]], [[r:ACT.18.15|Act 18:15]] (cf. ἀφ-, καθ-, προ-, συν-οράω). SYN.: see: βλέπω. (AS)
(οὐδαμός, not even one), adv., in no wise, by no means: [[r:MAT.2.6|Mat 2:6]] (OT).† (AS)

G3748.forms: ὅστις, ἥτις, ὅ τι (also written ὅ, τι and ὅτι; see LS, see word; WH, §411; Tdf., Pr., 111), in NT scarcely ever except in nom. (M, Pr., 91), the only instance of the oblique cases being found in ἕως ὅτου (see: ἕως), relative of indef. reference (related to simple ὅς as Lat. quisquis to qui)
G3748.strongs: which some, i.e. any that; also (definite) which same
G3748.kjv: X and (they), (such) as, (they) that, in that they, what(-soever), whereas ye, (they) which, who(-soever)
senses: whoever, anyone who;

of an indef. person or thing: in general statements, [[r:MAT.5.39|Mat 5:39, 41 13:12]], and freq., [[r:LUK.14.27|Luk 14:27]], [[r:GAL.5.4|Gal 5:4]], al.; in relative sentences, [[r:MAT.7.26|Mat 7:26]], [[r:LUK.15.7|Luk 15:7]], [[r:PHP.3.7|Php 3:7]], al.; πᾶς, with indic., [[r:MAT.7.24|Mat 7:24 10:32]]; ὅ ἄν (ἐάν), with subjc., [[r:MAT.12.50|Mat 12:50 13:12]], [[r:JHN.14.13|Jhn 14:13]], [[r:1CO.16.2|1Co 16:2]], [[r:GAL.5.10|Gal 5:10]], al.;

of a definite person or thing, indicating quality, "either generic, which, as other like things, or essential, which by its very nature" (Hort on [[r:1PE.2.11|1Pe 2:11]]), who is such as: [[r:MAT.2.6|Mat 2:6 7:26]], [[r:LUK.2.10|Luk 2:10 7:37]], [[r:JHN.8.53|Jhn 8:53]], [[r:ACT.7.53|Act 7:53]], [[r:ROM.6.2|Rom 6:2]], [[r:1CO.3.17|1Co 3:17]], [[r:GAL.4.24|Gal 4:24]], [[r:EPH.1.23|Eph 1:23]], al.; (with) where the relative sentence expresses a reason, consequence, etc. (M, Pr., 92), seeing that he (it, they), and he (it, they): [[r:LUK.8.3|Luk 8:3 10:42]], [[r:ACT.10.47|Act 10:47 11:28]], [[r:PHP.4.3|Php 4:3]], al.;
as in Ionic and late Greek (Bl., §50, 1; M, Pr., l.with), differing but little from ὅς: [[r:LUK.2.4|Luk 2:4 9:30]], [[r:ACT.17.10|Act 17:10]], [[r:REV.12.13|Rev 12:13]]. (AS)

G3704.strongs: what(-ever) how, i.e. in the manner that (as adverb or conjunction of coincidence, intentional or actual)
senses: ὅπως
I
Relat. adv. of manner, as, how: with indic., [[r:LUK.24.20|Luk 24:20.]]
II
Conj., with subjc. (in cl. also with opt., indic.: so in [[r:MAT.26.59|Mat 26:59]], LT, Tr.), in order that, to the end that, that;

final, denoting purpose or design (in which the original idea of modality has been merged): after pres., [[r:MAT.6.2|Mat 6:2]], al.; pf., [[r:ACT.9.17|Act 9:17]], al.; impf., [[r:ACT.9.24|Act 9:24]]; aor., [[r:ACT.9.2|Act 9:2]], al.; plpf., [[r:JHN.11.57|Jhn 11:57]]; fut., [[r:MAT.23.35|Mat 23:35]]; imperat., [[r:MAT.2.8|Mat 2:8]], al.; ὅ. μή (M, Pr., 185), [[r:MAT.6.18|Mat 6:18]], [[r:LUK.16.26|Luk 16:26]], [[r:ACT.20.16|Act 20:16]], [[r:1CO.1.29|1Co 1:29]]; ὅ. πληρωθῇ, [[r:MAT.2.23|Mat 2:23 8:17 13:35]]; ὅ. ἄν (B1., § 65, 2; WM, § 42, 5), [[r:LUK.2.35|Luk 2:35]], [[r:ACT.3.19|Act 3:19 15:17]], [[r:ROM.3.4|Rom 3:4]] (cf. [[r:GEN.12.13|Gen 12:13]], [[r:PSA.59.7|Psa 59:7]]. 1Mac 1032, al.).
After verbs of asking, exhorting, etc.: [[r:MAT.9.38|Mat 9:38]], [[r:LUK.7.3|Luk 7:3]], [[r:JAS.5.16|Jas 5:16]], al. (in late writers its place is often taken by the correl. πῶς, which see) (AS)
oὗ (prop. genitive of ὅς), adv. of place, where, whither;
in answer to the question "whither?" (= quo): [[r:MAT.28.16|Mat 28:16]], [[r:LUK.10.1|Luk 10:1 24:28]]; before ἐάν, with subjc., [[r:1CO.16.6|1Co 16:6.]]† (AS)

G3754.kjv: as concerning that, as though, because (that), for (that), how (that), (in) that, though, why
senses: conjc. (prop. neut. of ὅστις).
I
As conjc, introducing an objective clause, that;

after verbs of seeing, knowing, thinking, saying, feeling: [[r:MAT.3.9|Mat 3:9 6:32 11:25]], [[r:MRK.3.28|Mrk 3:28]], [[r:LUK.2.49|Luk 2:49]], [[r:JHN.2.22|Jhn 2:22]], [[r:ACT.4.13|Act 4:13]], [[r:ROM.1.13|Rom 1:13 8:38 10:9]], [[r:PHP.4.15|Php 4:15]], [[r:JAS.2.24|Jas 2:24]], al.; elliptically, [[r:JHN.6.46|Jhn 6:46]], [[r:PHP.3.12|Php 3:12]], al.

After εἶναι (γίνεσθαι): defining a demonstr. or of person(s) pron., [[r:JHN.3.19|Jhn 3:19 16:19]], [[r:ROM.9.6|Rom 9:6]], [[r:1JN.3.16|1Jn 3:16]] al.; with pron. interrog., [[r:MAT.8.27|Mat 8:27]], [[r:MRK.4.41|Mrk 4:41]], [[r:LUK.4.36|Luk 4:36]], [[r:JHN.4.22|Jhn 4:22]] al.; id. elliptically, [[r:LUK.2.49|Luk 2:49]], [[r:ACT.5.4|Act 5:4]], 9, al.;

Untranslatable, before direct discourse (ὅτι recitantis): [[r:MAT.7.23|Mat 7:23]], [[r:MRK.2.16|Mrk 2:16]], [[r:LUK.1.61|Luk 1:61]], [[r:JHN.1.20|Jhn 1:20]], [[r:ACT.15.1|Act 15:1]], [[r:HEB.11.18|Heb 11:18]], al. (on the pleonastic ὡς ὅτι, see: ὡς).
II

As causal particle, for that, because: [[r:MAT.5.4|Mat 5:4-12]], [[r:LUK.6.20|Luk 6:20, 21]], J0 1:30 5:27, [[r:ACT.1.5|Act 1:5]], [[r:1JN.4.18|1Jn 4:18]], [[r:REV.3.10|Rev 3:10]], al. mult.; διὰ τοῦτο ὅτι, [[r:JHN.8.47|Jhn 8:47 10:17]], al.; answering a question (διὰ τί), [[r:ROM.9.32|Rom 9:32]], al.; οὐκ ὅτι... ἀλλ᾽ ὅτι, [[r:JHN.6.26|Jhn 6:26 12:6]]. (AS)

G3725.root: neuter of a derivative of an apparently primary ὅρος (a bound or limit)
G3725.strongs: a boundary-line, i.e. (by implication) a frontier (region)
senses: (ὅρος, a boundary), a boundary, bound; chiefly in pl., and so always in NT: [[r:MAT.2.16|Mat 2:16 4:13 8:34 15:22, 39 19:1]], [[r:MRK.5.17|Mrk 5:17 7:24, 31 10:1]], [[r:ACT.13.50|Act 13:50]].† (AS)

G3772.root: perhaps from the same as [[w:G3735]] (through the idea of elevation)
G3772.strongs: the sky; by extension, heaven (as the abode of God); by implication, happiness, power, eternity; specially, the Gospel (Christianity)
senses: heaven;
